metodo: Geracao e edicao pela ferramenta integrada de imagens, com transparencia solicitada na geracao. Arquivos originais preservados, sem redimensionar ou recomprimir.

prompts.name: dark/corner_filigrane.png
prompts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production transparent PNG ornament for the RogueTales game UI.
Create ONE upper-left frame corner only, on a true transparent alpha background, square 1024x1024 canvas. Renaissance architecture engraving combined with delicate mandala finishing: elegant acanthus leaves, symmetrical arabesques, thin crisp continuous filigree, a tiny petal rosette at the elbow. The L-shaped corner has a horizontal arm extending right and a vertical arm extending down; mirror symmetry across its 45-degree diagonal. Long thin double border strokes, restrained small curls, open transparent negative space between every leaf. Flat orthographic front view, subtle shallow bevel rather than bulky 3D metal. Identical visual weight intended for a coherent modular UI kit. Palette DARK THEME: medium blue #3c95a9 strokes and pale blue #aceaf1 highlights, a tiny restrained soft blue glow and subtle #07253f edge shading INSIDE THE ORNAMENT ONLY. All surrounding areas and holes fully transparent. Center the entire L-shaped ornament in canvas with even 64px transparent safe margins; nothing cropped. No other corners, no complete frame, no text, letters, numbers, labels, characters, colored background, checkerboard, mockup, cast shadow or watermark. Output a single sharp isolated ornamental corner, NOT a sheet of multiple elements.

prompts.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. The reference image is the EDIT TARGET: a single Renaissance acanthus filigree upper-left L-shaped UI corner. Produce its LIGHT THEME companion. Preserve exactly the ornament, outline, acanthus leaf shapes, rosette, mirrored L-arm layout, cropping, stroke weights, clear interior holes, size and transparent canvas. Change only its material palette: warm muted gold and dark beige #ddbd82 with pale beige highlights #e5d0a1 and fine dark chestnut #3b2414 recesses. Restrained shallow engraved bevel, no excessive polished chrome, no blue anywhere. True transparent alpha background, no opaque paper, no black backdrop, no checkerboard painted into the image, no text or labels. One isolated corner only; all surrounding spaces and holes stay fully transparent.

prompts.name: dark/horizontal_border.png
prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. The reference is STYLE ONLY: reuse its blue palette, acanthus leaf shapes, fine Renaissance arabesques, subtle engraved bevel and crisp edges. Create ONE NEW asset, not the L corner: a horizontally repeatable ornamental border strip, wide landscape canvas about 4:1, transparent PNG. One horizontal row of three evenly spaced mirrored acanthus scroll motifs connected by delicate double parallel rails, with small eight-petal rosettes. Strict vertical center alignment and bilateral symmetry, no corner turns and no tapered decorative end caps: this is a REPEAT UNIT. Left and right ends must meet at the same line height, thickness, color and ornament phase for seamless horizontal repetition. Use ONLY medium teal-blue #3c95a9 and pale blue #aceaf1 with very fine #07253f internal recesses. Thin, restrained surface relief and very soft pale-blue highlight, not bulky metal. Transparent holes and background, absolutely no painted background or checkerboard; no opaque panel, no text, numbers, label, watermark, characters. Ornament centered vertically, generous clear space above and below; horizontal rails reach exactly to both image edges. Output just this ONE modular strip in its own image.

prompts.name: light/horizontal_border.png
prompts.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Recolor this ONE horizontal repeating blue Renaissance border strip into its LIGHT THEME version. Use muted golden beige #ddbd82 and pale beige #e5d0a1 highlights, with delicate chestnut brown #3b2414 recesses, NO BLUE, NO RED OR PINK GLOW. Shallow engraved relief. All negative spaces and background must be genuine transparent alpha; clean antialiasing without colored matte contamination or cast shadows. No text, symbols, extra motifs, background fill, paper or checkerboard. Output only the same repeatable horizontal strip, same geometry and placement, in warm gold/beige.

prompts.name: dark/section_divider.png
prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Reference image is STYLE ONLY for a matching Renaissance/acanthus/mandala UI ornament kit. Centered small intricate eight-petal mandala rosette, about one fifth the ornament width, with fine mirrored acanthus arabesques tapering gracefully left and right into two very thin parallel engraved horizontal rules. Entire divider bilaterally symmetrical, razor clean contours, delicate openwork, subtle low relief and restrained highlight. DARK THEME colors only: teal-blue #3c95a9 body, pale blue #aceaf1 highlights, fine dark navy #07253f inner shading. Lighter and more delicate than a large frame; large fully transparent spaces, no solid band or panel. Even transparent margins around all tips, nothing cropped. No text, labels, characters, border box, opaque background, paper, grid, checkerboard, watermark or decorative sheet. Just ONE centered divider in its own image.

prompts.name: dark/mandala_watermark.png
prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. The reference is STYLE ONLY, a Renaissance blue acanthus UI corner. Create a NEW single large circular mandala/rosette watermark ornament on a true transparent PNG square canvas. A precise, elegant, RADIAL SYMMETRIC eightfold Renaissance architectural rose window: eight slender petal loops around a small eight-petal central flower, nested fine circular engraved rings, graceful mirrored acanthus tendrils and delicate leaf tips inside the outer circle. Extremely airy OPEN LINEWORK with large transparent spaces; lighter and thinner than the reference corner, no thick filled disks or heavy jewelry. Fine crisp teal-blue #3c95a9 lines with pale blue #aceaf1 subtle highlights and only tiny navy #07253f recessed details. Restrained shallow bevel, no cast shadow or broad glow. Designed to be used at low opacity behind game text. Perfectly centered, balanced, symmetric, equal 7 percent transparent margins, whole circumference intact. No backdrop of any color, no opaque disk, no paper, no checkerboard, no text, letters, numbers, icons, characters, watermark signature or frame corners. Just one delicate openwork circular rosette.

prompts.name: dark/surface_texture.png
prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE seamless square TRANSPARENT ornamental background texture tile for a Renaissance/mandala game UI. This is subtle microtexture, NOT a large medallion, corner, frame or decorative object. Sparse, evenly distributed ultra-fine engraved acanthus curls, tiny eight-petal rosettes, delicate quatrefoil lattice traces and a little fine paper-engraving stipple, all at SMALL UNIFORM SCALE across the tile. Restrained density with plenty of completely transparent negative space. Flat fine linework, very shallow relief, no chrome or chunky filled objects. DARK THEME ink only muted medium blue #3c95a9 and a small amount of pale blue #aceaf1 highlights. Lines are semi-transparent so the tile remains a quiet texture when repeated behind text. CRITICAL: toroidally seamless repeating pattern with same motif phase at opposite edges; top connects bottom and left connects right without visible seams; no opaque colored background, no vignette, central spotlight, distinct focal center or enclosing border. Pattern reaches and wraps ALL FOUR edges. Absolutely no text, words, numbers, characters, paper rectangle, black fill, checkerboard or watermark. One isolated square tile with actual alpha transparency.

Change ONLY its blue color palette into LIGHT THEME warm muted gold/dark beige #ddbd82, small pale beige #e5d0a1 accents and chestnut brown #3b2414 fine lines. Extremely subtle flat microtexture with transparent negative spaces, for use behind UI text at very low opacity. Keep background fully transparent, no opaque parchment, no painted color field, no vignette, no border, no central focal object, no text, checkerboard or watermark. It must remain a seamless square repeat tile with the same pattern placement.

prompts.name: dark/panel_frame.png
prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Reference is STYLE ONLY, not a copy of the whole L composition. Create a SINGLE COMPLETE rectangular panel FRAME for a coherent Renaissance acanthus and mandala UI kit. Landscape 3:2 canvas. Four identical mirrored ornamental corners, each combining the reference's small eight-petal rosette and restrained acanthus scrolls. Four straight double borders connect them continuously. Crisp precise symmetric geometry, perfectly straight horizontal/vertical rails. Ornament clusters confined to outer corner zones (within 18 percent of width/height) so the four mid-edge segments are simple scalable rails suitable for nine-slice. Fine engraved low relief, understated pale highlights. DARK THEME ONLY: #3c95a9 medium-blue body, #aceaf1 light-blue highlights, #07253f fine recessed shading. ENTIRE LARGE CENTER OF THE FRAME MUST BE EMPTY AND FULLY TRANSPARENT ALPHA, as must the exterior and all openwork holes; this is a frame cutout, NOT a blue panel or painting. Keep all four corners entirely inside the canvas with 4 percent transparent padding, nothing cropped. Centered, left-right and top-bottom symmetric, no perspective. NO text, characters, objects, sample UI, opaque panel, scenery, colored background, checkerboard, drop shadow or watermark. One complete empty ornamental frame only.

No soft glow, no ambient color, no shadows, no colored rectangular plate. Only the actual engraved blue metal strokes and acanthus leaves survive. Do not add or redesign anything. True transparency.
